Sunday, 07 May, 2028: Absolute Monarchy and the Revolution

[spoiler=domino 1][quote=koranvistan;61479697]
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
[sub][list][b][i]►►Sovotschego and Corzerran Awarded Exclusive Tech and Data Center Contracts◀◀[/b]
As Crown continues to nationalize the business sectors.[/i][/list]
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------[/sub]
[i]Eida Mokoetsau, CEO of Sovotschego holdings, has been given control over the stalled Akr Project; an initially five-year program to expand the Akr regions data infrastructure under Governor Bruzhnikoyyas term. However, due to the Crowns assumption of many Kyraniyan projects, Akr was put on hold.
Now the project is back underway, alongside several CCTV network development projects. Those who express concern point to the already extant right hand, iron fisted nature of the Royal Affairs Ministry, and see SChG as the left.
[list][sub]"Its really not a big deal." Mokoetsau stated on a KBNC morning show. I like to think Id always choose the side of advancement, and of the people, and of the revolution. And thats all it really is.[/sub][/list]
Corzerrans tech businesses are also enjoying the benefits of exclusive contracts, and so are millions across the Kingdom. Connection in rural and poor Koranvistan has either been reduced in price, or made free altogether. And the nation is seeing record highs in the numbers of enrolled students.[/i][/quote][/spoiler]

Following the terrible attacks, the Crown (and specifically the mysterious RAM) have started working closely with Sovotschego on increased security. The company began maintaining its own private security, trained by the Royal Military. The tech giant now has its name on millions of cameras, recording devices, and espionage softwares across the whole kingdom. Due to the increased efficiency in investigations, the RAM and local departments were able to compile detailed dossiers on POIs within the Syndicate and Kingdom at large during phase 1 of Operation Continued Revolution. By the end of phase 1 the RAM and SovotsCheGo have complete profiles on Bruzhnikoyya, Kaaydell, Azemocyk, Stetsyuvosk, 4 Head Syndicate operatives (Vitaly "Draco" Sasanov, Nikodim Shevets', Tereza Tsorovik', and Viktor Kabalev), and 23 other POIs

[spoiler=domino 2][quote=koranvistan;61334567][b][u]Velnaz Times: December 22nd, 2027[/u][/b]

[u]Sovotschego Corporations New Island?[/u]
In a historic move for Ms. Eida Mokoetsaus tech-upstart-turned-giant Sovotschego, the shareholders approved the purchase of a 47 sq. km island for unspecific research and development.
When asked about this at a press meeting, Ms. Mokoetsau declined to comment, saying [i]Surprises, you know how they can be.[/i]
Denizens are, by and large, unsure of what this could mean. One anonymous young man, age 21, says this:
[i]Billionaires buying islands. Seen it before, but ashamed it's us now. Its gross, you know? They keep open secrets from us, and whatever comes out of that island will be a plot grosser than that of the worst devils.
Eh? What would I have done? Not put a monarch in power, guy. Old systems dont work anymore and I think even the Queen knows that. Three changes of the legislative body, nothing is getting done to stop this Sovotschego problem. The golden collars will be running us again soon, so shelter in place.[/i][/quote][/spoiler]

Phase 2 of the plan was to prepare SovotsCheGos R&D island to house political prisoners before they go to trial. During phase one, it was discovered that the Syndicate and Bruzhnikoyya (to a lesser extent, Kaaydell) had not only worked together to push the new constitution, but that they were in leagues with Yugo Stetsyuvosk as well.

Stetsyuvosk is a business mogul, the CEO of Stetsyuvosk Holdings and therefore the owner of Koranvistans largest (private) companies. The RAM, during a nighttime search of one of Stetsyuvosks many homes, found incriminating evidence on the whole conspiracy: enough to show the world why a few people were about to disappear.

The nail in the coffin was an email thread, about 16 messages long, that detailed an attack on two Corridor ports- the attack that took 26 Koranvistani lives. It was proof that Stetsyuvosk, Bruzhnikoyya, and the Syndicate were in conspiracy, and also that Stetsyuvosk is also Iosif Kabalev, allegedly dead Head Syndicate Operative.

And so phase 3 was set to begin the evening of May 7th, the anniversary of the 2nd battle of North Jko, the fight that secured the Kingdom for the revolutionaries. The Queen was to give a speech at the Palaces candlelight vigil held in honor of the lives lost. All the while, however, SovotsCheGo and the Royal Affairs Ministry were busy making thirty one arrests- Guilty Governors, CEOs, and Syndicate members were brought to the R&D island for questioning. Their statements were taken, and they were shown to their rooms.

And Elena spoke to her people on a clear night, pleased with the knowledge that her enemies would no longer pose a problem. It was 10:00 pm, the vigil would end at midnight. Cecilia Hyacint, Captain of the Royal Guard, stood tall at her right hand. Red, Veronika, and Susana stood behind, on a slightly elevated platform. Behind them, hanging on the Palace, is the Kingdoms tricolor with the Royal Insignia- the Laureled Flame.

And she spoke to her people for the last time as Queen:

[i]Were gathered here to remember the sacrifices made during our Revolution. Three years ago, the Republican forces surrendered our now great Kingdom to us. From there, we rebuilt, breathed life back into our cities and our countryside. Weve connected the nation through greater public infrastructure, new roads, and internet to our poorest areas. Weve brought the too long neglected people of our Country into the modern world.

And yet, weve had traitors to our Revolution hatch wicked plot after wicked plot to undermine the power we fought and died for. Governors Bruzhnikoyya and Kaaydell are unfortunately missing tonight, because theyve been found guilty of such scheming. Iosif Kabalev, who we thought dead, had been using the name Yugo Stetsyuvosk to carry out their plans. And the Sasanov Syndicate, detestable, power hungry criminals- they helped push it all into action. See, the awful plan they brought forth was an attack on two Corridor Facilities. They took the lives of our people, they took the lives of our loved ones.[/i]

The gathered crowd grew quiet, then very loud. Among their shouts, Bring them here! grew into an angry chorus. Elena paused for them to quiet.

[i]The responsible parties are being apprehended. It will be a long, long night for them. Ill make sure of it. Now, Stetsyuvosk or Kabalev, whatever you call him, he stood for the old systems. The supremacy of the wealthy, world of the highest bidder. But no longer!

The other conspirators will be brought out to sea, on a small island, where theyll receive their due justice. But Bruzhnikoyya, author of the draft constitution, and the architect of this plot: hell be brought here, so that the enemies of our Revolution will see their fate should they decide to stay.

To the wealthy elites who think that well harbor them- youre safe, but your days of unchecked wealth are over. And to you wannabe oligarchs, expect a modest living here in Koranvistan. Youll be comfortable, and youll be one of us till the day you die. Or you can pack up and take your practices elsewhere.

And one final note to my people:[/i] she paused and took a breath, [i]I swear, as your Monarch, the Leader of this new Revolutionary Empire, to protect our people until my legs collapse and my lungs give out. Because the Revolution isnt over until her enemies are dead. The Revolution isnt over until the last weed has been pulled and the Revolution isnt over until the old systems die and stop twitching.[/i]

She stayed silent until Bruzhnikoyya was brought forward a half hour later. He was tied at the hands and feet, forced to kneel in front of the crowd as they spat, threw drinks, and screamed. Elena pulled a weapon from her belt- the same one used to threaten him in the Assembly room, and executed the Governor before he knew she stood behind him.

She raised a fist high as a new flag unfurled- the flag of the Empire, and the flag of the continued Revolution. [i]For it is from these ashes that the Children will rise into Honor, Faith, and Power. Hail the Empire, and Hail her People.[/i]

[i]The Republic of Daesun is appalled by the United Lavian Republic's deliberate use of primitive tactics to "de-escalate" the situation, which has only brought about the  proliferation of tensions in the area. The nation's seizure of Daesunite assets, and vend to the hostile rogue state that is the Socialist Republic of Rosenmarkke is an escalation deemed unacceptable by the Republic of Daesun, and shall be met with thorough retaliatory action. As a state with self-declared neutrality in the Wuloosyan-Rosenmarkkett war, Daesun officially [b]condemns[/b] the United Lavian Republic for forcing her into a crisis she did not wish to be part of. 

All Lavian and Rosenmarkkett assets within Daesunite markets, or markets associated with the [url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2743488]P.E.C.A.[/url] shall be unreservedly seized by the Hanean Economic Council and redistributed to reinvestment relief funds for crisis-control. Additionally, Daesun shall employ a 20% baseline tariff on all Lavian goods, while also implementing successive tariffs on certain goods such as an 45% tariff on aircraft, 60% tariff on latex, and a final 100% tariff on Lavian petroleum.  

The United Lavian Republic shall be officially re-designated as a state sponsor of terrorism, as a subsequent action of its undeniable attempt to cause harm to Daesunite citizens economically. The Lavian embassy in Daesun shall be seized for the time being, and ambassadors are to be expelled from the country, while Daesunite ambassadors within Lavia will also vacate the state to Oceanica and Valonia. 

The Republic of Daesun will also seek the proliferation of its military presence in Western Argos to deter any further aggressive Lavian action to terrorize EDU member states and/or neutral countries, total servicemen deployments in Oceanica shall be bolstered from 15,000 to 28,000, and from 1,500 to 5,000 in Valonia.  In addition, under the greenlight of both President Bae Dae-hyun and Minister of Defense Hyon Yong-chol the RODNF shall dispatch the ESG-4 RODS Paik Sun-yup AAS to the perimeter of the West Argossian Strait, further military deployments are underway until the Lavian Republic's actions are resolved.[/i]

[quote=koranvistan;61429148][i]"Of course, your majesty."[/i] She nodded curtly and dismissed herself to her office, for there were schedules to be made.

Lunch was light fare, salad, soup, and either fish or chicken breast depending on guest choice. The meal passed with some idle chatter and the weeks' plans. Afterwards, Elena led the family on a brief tour of the Palace, showcasing the library, meeting hall, the beautiful campus and more.

Since there wasn't an itinerary till the next day, the rest of the evening was for leisure and conversation- except for Elena. She had gotten a call from one of the Governors, and she returned with stress playing on her face.

She waved a hand dismissively, [i]"No, no. The Governors, they've been trouble. But I had somewhat of a... clarifying conversation with the King. It's the follow through that worries me now."[/i] she chuckled dryly, [i]"But that's pillow talk,"[/i] she began moving towards the kitchen for coffee, [i]"The Royal Family has been delightful company, I got to learn a lot about you from the Princess."[/i] she laughed, strolling to the sink and filling a tea kettle and setting it on the stove.[/quote]
[i]"I'm glad things went well them them. I know they're not the kind to start up trouble, but I still worry that you might be overworking yourself."[/i]

Cecilia smirked as she leaned against the counter closest to Elena. [i]"So, what'd the Princess say? All good things, I hope?"[/i]

Someone should meet with the makers of such a device if they have time to humour us. But, we are not here to discuss myself. Though I do not shy away from the topic, research sharing, knowledge discussion. I believe you have something... magical?"[/b] The word sounds odd, magic is merely a science, why attach a fantasy novel invention to it?[/quote]

Agnieszka smiled. [i]"Some would call it magic. Many would. That is the word that is used to communicate topics about it to other nations, as it is difficult for many to understand when it is not called magic. In the Empire we typically call it something else. If in the government, it is called Reality Altering Ability, for, in simplest terms, that is what this 'magic' does. In the Church, it is called [b]Pleromite[/b]; it is an infinitesimal fraction of God's power and sovereignty over the world, and it is the means by which He commands it."[/i]

[i]"I hope that serves as a good introductory statement. There are many other areas of inquiry that are left open, and many properties of Pleromite that must be shown to be explained."[/i]

[quote=new_westmore;61535432]Grant begins to panick. The plane has already crossed V1, the point of no return for the takeoff. Against his better judgement, he attempts to abort the takeoff, slamming the throttles to idle, feathering the propellers and applying as much brake as he can. Much to their chagrin, the plane does not slow down fast enough, and Grant is forced to continue the roll.

The plane barely gets off the runway, and because of Grant's idiocy, the airplane's left propeller clips some of the antennas at the end. A loud crunch and a bang shakes the entire vehicle, and it immediately starts to veer left. Grant manages to fight the airplane and continues to drag the limping machine up into the air, having dealt with situations like this before. Amongst the pandemonium in the cabin, he calls in a mayday to the tower.

[i]"Edmundsen Tower, this is Whiskey November Golf Foxtrot Alpha, mayday mayday mayday, requesting vectors for immediate arrival."[/i]

The tower instructs them to do a loop around the city, and to come in for landing on the same runway they took off from. Grant obliges, and continues to wrestle with the stricken airplane as they take it for a ride around Edmundsen.

...

On the ground, police and emergency services are waiting for the airplane to arrive. The Air Force base at the airport is also on standby, waiting for the moment for the tower to tell them their bandits are doing the dumb thing and are trying to run away.

Upon inspecting the bag, airport personnel deduced that it was a roughly 500g pack of ground opium leaves, contraband by any legal measure in New Westmore. The tower was able to figure that NW-GFA, the airplane the three men are flying, must have been responsible for the bag. The tower already has a line of sight with their bandits, only aided by the plume of black smoke and the occasional burp of flames from the airplane's stricken left engine.

The air is tense. At any moment, that airplane could go careening and crash into the city below. They best hope that they manage to get back as soon as possible, preferably in one piece.[/quote]
